lab: openai_math hypothesis lab, night run 2026-10-07, lane H2
stage: preregistration; only timing probes and smoke tests below 1e7 have been run (disclosed below)

hypothesis.statement: For every fundamental discriminant D < -4: S(D) := L(1, chi_D) * log log|D| >= 2/5, with L(1, chi_D) = pi h(D) / sqrt|D|.
hypothesis.prior_evidence: results/openai_math/hypotheses/H2/result.json: min S = 0.40060 at D = -163 over 7 <= |D| <= 1e7; holdout (1e6, 1e7] min 0.53577 at D = -2383747. Upstream openai/math claims (family 003) are claims by another model, not results; H2(b) does not rest on them.

test_range.note: fresh range, never computed before in this lab: all fundamental D < 0 with 1e7 < |D| <= 1e8

statistic: min over the test range of S(D) (float64 via math.pi, math.sqrt, math.log), with argmin D and h at the argmin. Also reported (descriptive): min L(1, chi_D) with argmin; for each dyadic window (2^k, 2^(k+1)], k = 23..26 (partial windows at both ends), the min of S and of L with argmins; total count of fundamental D.
verdict_categories: CRASH (control failed; numbers are not evidence)
INCOMPLETE (chunks do not tile the range)

decision_rule.precondition: the chunk JSONs tile (1e7, 1e8] exactly (no gap, no overlap; check_tiling), else INCOMPLETE; all controls pass and all rechecks agree, else CRASH
decision_rule.PASS: min S over the test range >= 2/5
decision_rule.FAIL: min S over the test range < 2/5; report the counterexample D (the argmin) and its h
decision_rule.near_tie: if |min S - 0.4| < 1e-9 the comparison is redone at 50 digits with mpmath (exact_s_below)
decision_rule.deadline: if the range is not fully computed by 2026-10-08T06:00Z the verdict is INCOMPLETE; partial minima are descriptive only and no PASS/FAIL is claimed

class_number_instrument.primary: PARI qfbclassno(D) (Shanks baby-step giant-step). The PARI 2.13.3 documentation (??qfbclassno) states it 'gives unconditionally correct results for |D| < 2.10^10'. That is PARI's claim, not verified here.
class_number_instrument.recheck: PARI quadclassunit(D)[1] (independent algorithm, GRH-conditional) on, per chunk: the argmin of S, the argmin of L, every D with S < 0.5, and a deterministic sample of 64 D (every floor(n/64)-th fundamental D of the chunk). Any disagreement sets recheck_agrees = false for that chunk and lists it in recheck_mismatches; the run is then CRASH.
class_number_instrument.known_limitation: an overcount by qfbclassno at a D whose true S is < 0.4 and which is not in the recheck set would hide a counterexample; the guard against that is PARI's documented unconditional correctness below 2e10, not this lab.

checks: qfbclassno and quadclassunit both give h(-23)=3, h(-47)=5, h(-71)=7, h(-163)=1
the h = 1 list over fundamental |D| <= 200 is exactly the 9 Heegner discriminants {3,4,7,8,11,19,43,67,163}
regression slice: the new streaming code over (2^21, 2^22] reproduces the earlier runner's minimum S = 0.5357676931072192 at D = -2383747 (|diff| < 1e-12), all rechecks agreeing
h(D) = 1 never occurs in the test range: sum of chunk h1_count == 0 (Heegner-Baker-Stark; near-vacuous at this height, required anyway)

negative.statement: the wrong-order statistic U(D) = L(1, chi_D) (no log log factor) must drift down: min U over the last dyadic window (2^26, 1e8] < min U over the first window (1e7, 2^24]. All window minima are reported; strict window-to-window monotonicity is NOT required (log log changes about 1% per octave, below extreme-value noise).

controls.rule: a run whose positive or negative control fails is CRASH; its number is not evidence (program.md rule 1)

budget.cpu: 3 worker processes (ProcessPoolExecutor max_workers=3); PARI default(nbthreads, 1) in every worker
budget.chunking: 180 chunks (lo, hi] of width 500000; each chunk JSON written atomically (tmp file + os.replace); reruns skip finished chunks; each 'run' call stops submitting new chunks after --budget-s 240 (worst chunk ~56 s uncontended, ~170 s at 3x contention) so a Bash call ends within 9 minutes; every positive/run Bash call is given an explicit 540000 ms timeout
budget.timing_probe: qfbclassno over 20000 consecutive |D| took 1.99 s at 1e7, 2.18 s at 5e7, 2.25 s at 1e8-2e4 (single process, machine load average 2.4-4.5 on 8 cores); quadclassunit took 4.4 / 5.45 / 5.98 s on the same blocks
budget.expected_runtime: 4500 blocks of 20000 |D| x ~2.15 s = ~9700 CPU-s, plus ~11.7k quadclassunit rechecks at ~1 ms (~12 s), plus the positive control (1-3 min); over 3 workers ~54 min uncontended; with a 2-3x contention factor from other lanes 1.8-2.7 h. Start ~21:50Z, expected finish 22:45Z to 00:35Z, well before 06:00Z, so the full range up to 1e8 is preregistered (no smaller upper limit).

code.aggregate_checks_runner_sha256_against_t: enforced: a runner sha256 different from code.runner.sha256 here, or a missing preregistration.json, makes the verdict CRASH (decide())
